filter-on-desc: Ggwe biri filtering kaadi ku kino lubaawo. Click here eri kyusa sengeka.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Sengejja ennaku za kaadi ng’okozesa @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt oba @listEnteredAt. Ekyokulabirako: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' oba @endAt = none. Teeka erinnya ly’ekifo kye weetegekedde eritandika ne @ wakati w’obubonero obw’okujuliza.
advanced-filter-description: Advanced Sengeka allows eri write string containing following operators: ==!= <= >= && || ( ) space kiri kyakozesebwa nga separator between Operators. Ggwe sobola sengeka ku lwa byonna ennimiro ez'enjawulo nga typing byabwe names ne miwendo. Ku lwa Example: Nnimiro1 == Muwendo1. Note: Singa nnimiro oba miwendo contains spaces, ggwe need eri encapsulate them into single quotes. Ku lwa Example: 'Nnimiro 1' == 'Muwendo 1'. Ku lwa single control characters (' \/) eri ba skipped, ggwe sobola kozesa \. Ku lwa example: Nnimiro1 == I\'m. Also ggwe sobola combine multiple conditions. Ku lwa Example: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Normally byonna operators biri interpreted okuva kkono eri ddyo. Ggwe sobola kyusa order nga placing brackets. Ku lwa Example: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Also ggwe sobola noonya bigambo nnimiro ng'okozesa regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Kikwatagana ekaadi bweteekebwawo, oba omutwe oba ennyinyonyola yaayo bwe kikyusibwa, era ebigambo ebipya bwe biba nga birimu kino (enkuyunjula z'ennukuta ennene n'entono tezisosola).
imported-member-no-account: Yaleeta memba — nedda matching akaawunti yet
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Teekamu Kanboard fulumya JSON: object na "columns" (oba mirimu carrying column_name) ne "tasks" array (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns become nkalala ne mirimu become kaadi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Teekamu NextCloud Deck lubaawo JSON ( lubaawo na "stacks", each stack carrying kyakyo "cards"). Stacks become nkalala ne kaadi become kaadi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Teekamu OpenProject work-packages collection JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses become nkalala ne work packages become kaadi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Teekamu __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues become kaadi grouped into Ggulawo / Closed nkalala.
import-board-instruction-asana: Teekamu Asana mirimu fulumya JSON ({ "data": [...] } okuva Asana fulumya oba GET /tasks). Mirimu biri grouped into sections (memberships); kiwedde mirimu go eri Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Teekamu ZenKit lukalala fulumya JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages become nkalala ne items become kaadi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Kwatako olukalala lw'emirimu olwa markdown (empisa emikozesebwa ebikozesebwa markdown-kanban nga Obsidian Kanban): emitwe "## Erinnya ly'olukalala", n'ebintu "- [ ]"/"- [x]" wansi. Emitwe gifuuka olukalala n'ebintu bifuuka kaadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Siiga ensengeka ya Leo (fayiro ya .leo). Ebitundu eby'oku mutendera ogw'oku ntikko bifuuka enkalala, ebitundu ebiri wansi waabyo butereevu bifuuka kaadi, era ebiwandiiko by'ekitundu bifuuka ennyonyola ya kaadi. Ebitundu eby'oku mitendera egy'omu munda ennyo bifuuka enkalala z'okukebera. Ebitundu ebiteereddwako akabonero biyingizibwa nga ebiwedde.
import-board-instruction-opml: Teekamu OPML outline, nga Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq n'ebirala bwe bigifulumya. Ebintu eby'oku ntikko bifuuka enkalala, abaana baabyo bifuuka kaadi nga ebbaluwa efuuka ennyonyola, n'ebintu ebiri wansi ennyo bifuuka enkalala z'okukebera. Ebintu ebyaggwa biyingizibwa nga biwedde.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Teekamu fayiro ya Org mode, nga Emacs, Orgzly oba Beorg bwe bigiwandiika. Emitwe egy'oku ntikko gifuuka enkalala n'emitwe egy'omutendera ogwokubiri gifuuka kaadi. TODO ne DONE, obukulu, obubonero, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ne CLOSED bikuumibwa, n'obusanduuko bw'okukebera n'emitwe egiri wansi ennyo bifuuka enkalala z'okukebera.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Teeka fayiro ya todo.txt: omulimu gumu ku buli lunyiriri, nga pulogulaamu ya todo.txt ne pulogulaamu ezikwatagana bwe zigiwandiika. Emirimu egyaggwa ("x") gigenda mu Giwedde, +project ne @context bifuuka obubonero, (A) efuuka akabonero k'obukulu, era due: ne t: bifuuka ennaku ez'okusibako n'ez'okutandika.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Ssaawo ebivudde mu task export: olukalala lwa JSON oba omulimu gumu ku buli lunyiriri. Emirimu egyaggwa gigenda mu Done, project ne priority bifuuka obubonero, annotations efuuka endowooza, ate depends efuuka okwesigama ku mirimu egiziyiza.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ggya fayiro ya .boardarchive mu zip era osseewo ebiri mu board.jsonl y’olubaawo, n’olunyiriri lw’ekika oba nga teruliiko. Ekintu ekigabanya mu bibinja mu ndabika y’olubaawo kifuuka enkalala, ebintu ebirala eby’okulonda bifuuka obubonero, ebitundu by’ebiwandiiko n’obubokisi obw’okuteekamu akabonero bifuuka ennyonyola n’olukalala lw’okukebera, era endowooza zikuumibwa. Ebifaananyi ne fayiro ezigattiddwako tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Mu MeisterTask, nyiga ku linnya lya pulojekiti, londa Export project ofulumye CSV, oluvannyuma ogiteekemu. Ebitundu bifuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi, n'ebbaluwa zaagyo, olunaku olusembayo, aweereddwa omulimu n'obubonero; emirimu egyaggwa gikuuma olunaku lwe gyaggwerako. CSV ewandiikiddwa olw'okuyingiza kwa MeisterTask yennyini nayo ekola.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Mu Obsidian, ggulawo fayiro y'olubaawo lwa Kanban nga Markdown (oba ggulawo fayiro .md mu kawandiisi k'ebigambo), oluvannyuma oteekemu yonna. Emikutu gifuuka enkalala n'ekkomo lyazo erya kaadi, kaadi zikuuma obubonero bwazo, ennaku, obukulu, ennimiro n'olukalala lw'okukebera, ne Archive efuuka kaadi eziri mu Tterekero.
import-board-instruction-linear: Mu Linear, fulumya ensonga nga CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, oba okufulumya kw'endabika), oluvannyuma oteekemu CSV. Embeera zifuuka enkalala, ttiimu zifuuka obukubo, n'ensonga zifuuka kaadi n'aweereddwa omulimu, obubonero, ennaku, ensonga enkulu, obukulu, okubalirira, pulojekiti ne cycle.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Mu TickTick, ggulawo Settings, Account, Backup & Import okole backup, oluvannyuma oteekemu fayiro ya CSV. Buli lukalala lwa TickTick lufuuka akakubo n'empagi zaalwo zifuuka enkalala; emirimu gikuuma obubonero bwagyo, ennaku, olukalala lw'okukebera, obukulu n'emirimu emitono.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Mu ClickUp, fulumya emirimu nga CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, oba okufulumya kw'endabika ya List oba Table n'empagi zonna), oluvannyuma oteekemu CSV. Embeera zifuuka enkalala, enkalala za ClickUp zifuuka obukubo, n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi n'emirimu emitono, abaweereddwa omulimu, obubonero, ennaku, obukulu n'obudde.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Mu Nullboard, ggulawo olubaawo, londa Export this board... okuva ku menu, ggulawo fayiro .nbx mu kawandiisi k'ebigambo oteekemu by'erimu. Enkalala zifuuka enkalala n'ebbaluwa zifuuka kaadi: olunyiriri olusooka olw'ebbaluwa lwe linnya lya kaadi n'ebisigadde ennyonyola yaayo. Ebbaluwa embisi efuna akabonero raw. Fayiro erimu embaawo eziwerako eyingiza olubaawo lwayo olusooka.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Mu Kanri, ggulawo Import & Export olonde Export individual board (oba Export all data), oluvannyuma oteekemu fayiro .json. Empagi zifuuka enkalala ne kaadi zifuuka kaadi, n'ennyonyola yaazo, olunaku olusembayo, obubonero ne langi; emirimu gya kaadi gifuuka olukalala lw'okukebera. Okuva mu kufulumya kwa data yonna, olubaawo olusooka lwe luyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-planka: Wandiika endagiriro ya Planka yo (okugeza https://planka.example.com), erinnya ly'omukozesa ne ekigambo ekyekusifu ebya Planka, olwo onyige «Laga ebiyinza okuyingizibwa». Bikozesebwa kuleeta lubaawo lwokka era tebiterekebwa. Londa olubaawo onyige «Leeta»: WeKan alusoma okuva mu API ya Planka n'enkalala zaalwo, ekaadi, ennyinyonnyola, ennaku ez'okumaliriza, obubonero, abamemba, enkalala z'emirimu n'endowooza, olwo weeyongere okuyingiza nga bulijjo. Ekaadi eziri mu tterekero lya Planka ziyingizibwa nga ziterekeddwa; ebigattiddwako n'ekaadi eziri mu kasasiro tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Mu Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), yingira, kkiriza olukusa Tasks.Read era koppa token okuva ku kitundu Access token. Giteeke wano onyige «Laga ebiyinza okuyingizibwa»; token ekozesebwa ku kuleeta kuno kwokka era teterekebwa. Londa enkalala zonna oba olumu onyige «Leeta». Buli lukalala lwa To Do lufuuka olukalala ate buli mulimu ekaadi, n'ebiwandiiko byagwo, ennaku ez'okumaliriza n'ez'okutandika, emitendera ng'olukalala lw'okukebera, ebika ng'obubonero, obukulu obw'enkukunala n'embeera ng'obubonero; emirimu egyaggwa giterekebwa. Ebijjukizo n'okuddiŋŋana tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Mu KanbanFlow, ggulawo menu y'olubaawo, londa Settings → API & Webhooks era koppa API token y'olubaawo. Teeka token wano, nyiga «Laga ebiyinza okuyingizibwa», londa olubaawo onyige «Leeta»; token ekozesebwa ku kuleeta okwo kwokka era teterekebwa. Empagi zifuuka enkalala n'obukubo busigala bukubo; emirimu gisigaza ennyinyonnyola, langi, obubonero, olunaku olw'okumaliriza, emirimu emitono ng'olukalala lw'okukebera, obudde obwakozesebwa, okuteebereza, abantu n'endowooza.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Wandiika ID ya akawunti yo eya Basecamp (ennamba eddirira basecamp.com/ mu ndagiriro) ne token y'okuyingira (okuva mu app ya OAuth 2 ewandiisiddwa ku launchpad.37signals.com, oba gye kampuni egattiddwa eriko dda), nyiga «Laga ebiyinza okuyingizibwa», londa pulojekiti onyige «Leeta». Token ekozesebwa ku kuleeta okwo kwokka era teterekebwa. Buli kipande kya kaadi kifuuka akakubo n'empagi zaakyo ng'enkalala, ate enkalala z'eby'okukola zifuuka akakubo «To-dos»; ekaadi n'eby'okukola bisigaza ebiwandiiko, ennaku, abaweereddwa n'endowooza, emitendera gy'ekaadi gifuuka olukalala lw'okukebera, n'eby'okukola ebyaggwa biterekebwa.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Funa token y'okuyingira okuva mu OAuth 2.0 Playground: wansi wa Tasks API v1 londa tasks.readonly, nyiga Authorize APIs, olwo Exchange authorization code for tokens, era koppa token y'okuyingira. Giteeke wano onyige «Laga ebiyinza okuyingizibwa», londa enkalala z'emirimu zonna oba olumu, olwo «Leeta». Token ekozesebwa ku kuleeta kuno kwokka era teterekebwa. Enkalala z'emirimu zifuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka ekaadi, n'ebiwandiiko, enkolagana n'olunaku olw'okumaliriza; emirimu emitono gifuuka olukalala lw'okukebera n'emirimu egyaggwa giyingizibwa nga giterekeddwa.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API ya Google Keep ya akawunti za Google Workspace zokka. Funa token y'okuyingira eya OAuth 2.0 ng'erina scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (mu OAuth 2.0 Playground singa omukulu wa Workspace yo akkiriza, oba okuva mu akawunti ya service erina okukwasizibwa kwa domain yonna), giteekeyo, nyiga «Laga ebiyinza okuyingizibwa» olwo «Leeta». Token ekozesebwa ku kuleeta kuno kwokka era teterekebwa. Ebiwandiiko eby'ebigambo bifuuka ekaadi mu lukalala «Notes», n'ebiwandiiko eby'olukalala lw'okukebera bifuuka ekaadi mu lukalala «Lists» n'ebintu byabyo ng'olukalala lw'okukebera. Ebiri mu kasasiro, ebigattiddwako n'okugabana tebiyingizibwa.
api-import-desc: Kireete okuva ku service ne akawunti yo. By'owandiika wano bikozesebwa ku kuleeta kuno kwokka era tebiterekebwa.
api-import-fetched: Kireeteddwa. Kebera abamemba wansi era oyingize.
api-import-nothing: Tewali kya kuyingiza ne akawunti eno.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Mu Pivotal Tracker, ggulawo ttabu MORE eya pulojekiti olonde Export CSV (oba londa emboozi olonde Bulk Actions, CSV), oluvannyuma oteekemu CSV. Buli mbeera y'emboozi efuuka olukalala n'emboozi zifuuka kaadi, n'ekika kyazo n'obubonero, bannannyini, eyasaba, ennaku, endowooza, emirimu n'ebiziyiza; Estimate efuuka Story points n'enkulungo zifuuka sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Mu Tasks.org, ggulawo Settings, Backups olonde Export tasks, oluvannyuma oteekemu by'erimu mu fayiro eyo .json. Enkalala zifuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi, n'ebbaluwa zaagyo, obubonero, ennaku, endowooza n'emirimu emitono; emirimu egyaggwa gikuuma olunaku lwe gyaggwerako, n'obukulu bufuuka ennimiro ey'enjawulo.
import-board-instruction-monday: Mu monday.com, ggulawo menu y'olubaawo, londa More actions ne Export board to Excel (n'ebipya n'ebintu ebitono bw'oba oyagala), oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo .xlsx. Empagi ya Status efuuka enkalala n'ebibinja bifuuka obukubo; abantu, ennaku, timeline n'obubonero bikuuma ebifo byabyo, empagi endala zifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo n'ebipya bifuuka endowooza.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Mu Super Productivity, ggulawo Settings, oluvannyuma Sync & Backup, londa Export Data oteekemu by'erimu mu fayiro sp-backup .json. Buli pulojekiti efuuka akakubo n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi mu To Do, In Progress, Backlog oba Done, n'ebbaluwa zaagyo, obubonero, olunaku olusembayo, obudde obwakozesebwa n'emirimu emitono; emirimu egiri mu Tterekero gifuuka kaadi eziri mu Tterekero.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Mu Taiga, ggulawo Admin > Project > Export owanule dump ya pulojekiti (sooka osumulule fayiro .json.gz), oluvannyuma oteekemu JSON yaayo. Embeera za user story zifuuka enkalala, user stories zifuuka kaadi n'emirimu gyazo nga emirimu emitono, epics n'ensonga bifuna obukubo bwabyo, era sprints, obubonero, endowooza n'ebifaananyi eby'enjawulo bijja wamu. Ebiyungiddwako tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Mu Vikunja, ggulawo Settings, londa Data Export owanule fayiro .zip gy'ekuweereza, oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo, oba oteekemu data.json erimu. Ebibbo bya Kanban bifuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi, n'obubonero bwagyo, abaweereddwa omulimu, ennaku, ennyonyola, enkalala z'emirimu nga enkalala z'okukebera n'endowooza; obukulu, ebitundu ku kikumi ebyaggwa ne done bifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo. Ebiyungiddwako tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-quire: Mu Quire, ggulawo menu ya pulojekiti olonde Export CSV, oluvannyuma oteekemu CSV. Embeera zifuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi, n'emirimu emitono nga kaadi z'abaana, abaweereddwa omulimu, obubonero nga obubonero, ennaku ez'okutandika, ez'okusembayo n'ez'okuggwa, ennyonyola n'obukulu nga ennimiro ey'enjawulo. Endowooza n'ebiyungiddwako tebiri mu CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Mu Wrike, fulumya pulojekiti oba folda okugiteeka mu Excel, oba jjuza template y'okuyingiza Excel eya Wrike, oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo .xlsx. Ennyiriri za folda ne pulojekiti zifuuka obukubo, Status efuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi, ne Key yaagyo, omulimu omukulu, abaweereddwa omulimu, ennaku ez'okutandika n'ez'okuggwa, ebyesigamiziddwako n'ennyonyola; Priority, Duration n'empagi endala zifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Mu Teamwork.com, jjuza template y'okuyingiza emirimu mu Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ogitereke nga .xlsx, oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo. Enkalala z'emirimu zifuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi; omulimu ogutandika ne -, # oba > gufuuka omulimu omutono ogw'omulimu oguli waggulu waagwo (--, ## oba >> omutendera gumu wansi). Abaweereddwa omulimu, ennaku n'obubonero bikuuma ebifo byabyo; Priority, Estimated time ne Complete bifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Mu Businessmap (edda Kanbanize), ggulawo Advanced Search, londa Configure results okulonda empagi, wanula fayiro ya Excel, oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo .xlsx. Empagi zisomebwa n'amannya gaazo ag'Olungereza (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): akawunti yo bw'ekozesa olulimi olulala, sooka okyuse olunyiriri lw'emitwe lubeere mu Lungereza. Column efuuka enkalala ne Lane obukubo; bannannyini, obubonero, langi, ennaku, endowooza ne link z'abazadde bikuuma ebifo byabyo, ne Priority, Size, Type n'empagi endala zifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Mu Redmine, ggulawo Issues za pulojekiti, londa Also available in: CSV wansi w'olukalala, londa empagi (All columns, ne Description) ofulumye, oluvannyuma oteekemu CSV. Redmine etuuma empagi mu lulimi lwo, kale teeka olulimi lwo ku Lungereza mu My account nga tonnafulumya. Buli mbeera efuuka olukalala n'ensonga zifuuka kaadi, ne tracker nga akabonero, aweereddwa omulimu, omuwandiisi, ennaku, omulimu omukulu n'ensonga ezikwatagana; obukulu, ekika, version egendererwa, obudde obubaliriddwa, % Done n'ennimiro ez'enjawulo bifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo.
import-board-instruction-notion: Mu Notion, ggulawo database nga olupapula olujjuvu, londa ••• ne Export, londa Markdown & CSV, olonde fayiro .zip gy'ewanula, oba CSV emu eya database okuva mu yo, oba oteekemu CSV eyo. Empagi erinnya Status efuuka enkalala (bw'etabaawo, empagi esooka efaanana nga select y'ekola, era alipoota y'okuyingiza egamba eriwa); ennyiriri zifuuka kaadi n'erinnya lyazo, obubonero nga obubonero, abantu nga bamemba, ennaku, n'ebigambo by'olupapula nga ennyonyola; empagi endala zifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo. Enkolagana, ebifaananyi n'ebiyungiddwako tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-plane: Mu Plane, ggulawo Workspace Settings, londa Exports, fulumya pulojekiti nga JSON, CSV oba Excel owanule fayiro .zip, oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo, oba fayiro emu okuva munda mu yo, oba oteekemu JSON oba CSV. Embeera zifuuka enkalala, pulojekiti zifuuka obukubo, n'ensonga zifuuka kaadi n'akabonero kaazo, omuzadde, abaweereddwa omulimu, obubonero, ennaku, link n'endowooza; obukulu, okubalirira, cycle ne module bifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo. Okufulumya kwa Plane tekulina nnyonyola wadde ebiyungiddwako, kale tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-trello: Mu kyo Trello lubaawo, go eri 'Menu', olwo 'More', 'Print ne Export', 'Fulumya JSON', ne koppa resulting bigambo.
import-board-instruction-csv: Teekamu mu kyo Comma Separated Miwendo(CSV)/ Tab Separated Miwendo (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Teekamu JSON okuva Jira Cloud REST API issue noonya (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), oba equivalent { "issues": [...] } object. Jira statuses become nkalala ne issues become kaadi. Optionally include "automationRules" array eri leeta mateeka.
import-board-instruction-excel: Londa WeKan-style.xlsx spreadsheet ( kimu columns nga Excel fulumya: Mutwe, Kunnyonnyola, Mbeera/Lukalala, Bamemba, Obubonero, dates, ennimiro ez'enjawulo). kisooka row kiri header.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Mu kyo lubaawo, go eri 'Menu', olwo 'Fulumya board', ne koppa bigambo mu downloaded fayiro.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Singa ggwe get errors nga importing lubaawo, sometimes importing still works, ne lubaawo kiri ku embaawo zonna muko.
import-members-mode-map: Londa omukozesa aliwo eri buli omu ku bo
import-members-mode-placeholder: Bakuume nga abakozesa ab'ekifo n'amannya gaabwe, okubagatta ku bakozesa ab'amazima oluvannyuma
csv-mapping-description: Londa empagi ya fayiro erimu buli nnimiro ya kaadi. Ebirondeddwa byakolebwa okuva ku mannya g'empagi; kyusa byonna ebikyamu, era londa (tekiri mu fayiro) ku nnimiro fayiro gy'etalina.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Fayiro terina mpagi ya lukalala. Londa emu waggulu, oba wandiika erinnya ly'olukalala olumu buli kaadi mw'egenda.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Empagi endala ez'okuyingiza nga ennimiro ez'enjawulo ez'ebigambo:
csv-mapping-title-required: Londa empagi erimu amannya ga kaadi.
csv-mapping-list-required: Wandiika erinnya ly'olukalala buli kaadi mw'egenda, oba londa empagi erimu olukalala.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Searches sobola include operators eri refine noonya. Operators biri specified nga writing operator linnya ne muwendo separated nga colon. Ku lwa example, operator specification lya `lukalala:Blocked` would limit noonya eri kaadi ekyo biri contained mu lukalala named *Blocked*. Singa muwendo contains spaces oba special characters kyo kiteekwa ba enclosed mu quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"Eri Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - kaadi ekyo have kabonero matching *<color>* oba *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - kaadi belonging eri lubaawo assigned eri ekitongole *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - kaadi belonging eri lubaawo assigned eri tiimu *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kaadi ki biri due up eri *<n>* nnaku okuva now. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ nkalala byonna kaadi past byabwe ennaku ey'ekkomo.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kaadi ki byali yatonda *<n>* nnaku ago oba bitono
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - kaadi ki byali modified *<n>* nnaku ago oba bitono
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - wa *<field>* kiri one lya `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` oba `__predicate_member__`. Placing `-` mu front lya *<field>* searches ku lwa absence lya muwendo mu ekyo nnimiro (e.g. `has:-due` searches ku lwa kaadi awatali ennaku ey'ekkomo).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - wa *<sort-name>* kiri one lya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` oba `__predicate_modified__`. Ku lwa descending tegeka, place `-` mu front lya tegeka linnya.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - wa *<n>* kiri positive integer expressing namba lya kaadi eri ba displayed per muko.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Similar operators biri *Oba*ed together. Kaadi ekyo match kyonna lya conditions kijja ba returned.
`__operator_list__:Kiriwo __operator_list__:Blocked` would return kaadi contained mu kyonna lukalala named *Blocked* oba *Kiriwo*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Differing operators biri *Ne*ed together. Kyokka kaadi ekyo match byonna lya differing operators biri returned. `__operator_list__:Kiriwo __operator_label__:red` returns kyokka kaadi mu lukalala *Kiriwo* na *red* kabonero.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Nnaku sobola ba specified nga positive oba negative integer oba ng'okozesa `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` oba `__predicate_year__` ku lwa ekiriwo period.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Nga ekya bulijjo kyaterekebwa kaadi biri si searched.

feature-views-table-desc: Olubaawo nga kipande ky'amakaadi agasobola okusengekebwa.
feature-views-overview-desc: Ebibalo, okugatta ng'osinziira ku muntu aweereddwa omulimu, enteekateeka y'omulimu, olubaawo lw'ebipimo n'olubaawo olunene.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Engeri essatu ez'okulaba ebipande bya Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Emirimu gy'ekintu egisigadde, ebiseera ebimpi eby'okukola, lipoota y'ekiseera ekyo n'embiro z'okukola.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Emirimu egisigadde, emirimu egiwedde, entambula ekung'aanyiziddwa, ekiseera ky'okukola n'eky'okulinda, obungi bw'emirimu egiwedde, ekiseera emirimu ky'emaze ng'erinda, ebiziyiza, Monte Carlo n'ebipimo ebirala eby'entambula y'emirimu.
feature-approval-required: Kuuma ebikozesebwa ebyongerwako mu nkyukakyuka za WeKan nga tebitandikiddwa okutuusa omuddukanya lw'anaabitandika
feature-preview-admins: Abaddukanya balaba ebikozesebwa ebitatandikiddwa babigezese okusooka
feature-pilot-users: Abakozesa abagezesa nabo abalaba ebikozesebwa ebitatandikiddwa
card-field-visibility-desc: Ennimiro za Entegeka y'Olubaawo / Kaadi embaawo ze zisobola okulaga. Ennimiro etakubiddwako kabonero ekwekebwa ku buli kaadi, kaadi entono ne Entegeka y'Olubaawo / Kaadi eya buli lubaawo. Tewali data ya kaadi wadde entegeka y'olubaawo ekyuka, era okugikubako akabonero nate kulaga buli lubaawo nga bwe lwategekebwa. Ensengeka y'ennimiro ya buli lubaawo yennyini.
cards-loading-auto: Automatic (lazy kyokka ku lwa big mbaawo)
cards-loading-description: WeKan loads lubaawo kaadi kyokka: big lubaawo (over bunene threshold) loads kyokka kaadi currently kirabika (infinite scroll) plus live obungi, so kyo stays fast ne uses bitono memory ne bandwidth, while smaller mbaawo load every kaadi ku lwa simplest, fully featured experience. There kiri nothing eri configure. Operators sobola still force nkola na Kaadi_Kitikka (byonna/lazy/auto) ne Kaadi_Kitikka_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Lazy kaadi kitikka kiri experimental: kaadi counters ne WIP limits biri accurate, but Calendar/Table/Gantt views ne multi-select reflect kyokka kaadi loaded so far. Reload ggulawo mbaawo after changing kino.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Nga kisobozeseddwa, byonna obukwate (both markdown obukwate like [kabonero](url) ne raw HTML <a href> tags) biri always shown nga plain, non-clickable bigambo mu every rich bigambo nnimiro (lubaawo ne kaadi titles, descriptions, ebiteeso, checklists, etc.). Kino prevents misleading clickable obukwate. Ekya bulijjo kiri off, so obukwate stay clickable.
always-show-code-as-text: Always laga byonna code nga plain bigambo
always-show-code-as-text-description: Nga kisobozeseddwa, rich bigambo kiri never rendered nga markdown oba HTML: entire source kiri always shown nga plain bigambo mu every rich bigambo nnimiro (lubaawo ne kaadi titles, descriptions, ebiteeso, checklists, etc.). Kino reveals hidden birimu — HTML ebiteeso (<!-- -->), target lya markdown obukwate, JavaScript ne kyonna kirala code — so byonna code kiri always kirabika, si clickable, ne si running. Ekya bulijjo kiri off, so markdown kiri rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: Nga kisobozeseddwa, byonna leeta features biri turned off: importing lubaawo okuva WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ne Forgejo, nga well nga cloning lubaawo. leeta menyu options biri hidden ne seva rejects kyonna leeta request. Ekya bulijjo kiri off.
disable-all-export-description: Nga kisobozeseddwa, byonna fulumya features biri turned off: exporting lubaawo nga WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, oba eri NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ne single-attachment fulumya. fulumya menyu options biri hidden ne seva rejects kyonna fulumya request. Ekya bulijjo kiri off.
disable-import-avatars-description: Nga kisobozeseddwa, avatars (mukozesa profile pictures) biri never yaleeta. Kino covers WeKan JSON leeta, Trello leeta, ne avatar sync okuva external identity providers ku okuyingira (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names ne kirala mawulire biri still yaleeta; kyokka avatars biri skipped. Ekya bulijjo kiri off.
disable-export-avatars-description: Nga kisobozeseddwa, avatars (mukozesa profile pictures) biri never included nga exporting lubaawo (WeKan JSON ne CSV fulumya). Usernames ne kirala mawulire biri still exported; kyokka avatars biri omitted. Ekya bulijjo kiri off.
anonymize-import-users-description: Nga kisobozeseddwa, importing WeKan JSON lubaawo replaces every yaleeta user's erinnya-ly'omukozesa, kijjudde linnya ne initials na counter placeholders (mukozesa1, mukozesa2,...), drops byabwe avatar, ne rewrites @erinnya-ly'omukozesa mentions (ne requested-by / assigned-by nnimiro) inside yaleeta kaadi ne ky'okwogera birimu. Nedda real mukozesa identity okuva source lubaawo kiri stored. word "mukozesa" follows lulimi lya muntu importing. Ekya bulijjo kiri off.
anonymize-export-users-description: Nga kisobozeseddwa, exporting lubaawo replaces every exported user's erinnya-ly'omukozesa, kijjudde linnya ne initials na counter placeholders (mukozesa1, mukozesa2,...), drops byabwe avatar, ne rewrites @erinnya-ly'omukozesa mentions (ne requested-by / assigned-by nnimiro) inside kaadi ne ky'okwogera birimu. exported fayiro carries nedda real mukozesa identity. word "mukozesa" follows lulimi lya muntu exporting. Ekya bulijjo kiri off.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Nga kisobozeseddwa, exporting lubaawo replaces every exported user's erinnya-ly'omukozesa, kijjudde linnya ne initials na counter placeholders (mukozesa1, mukozesa2,...), drops byabwe avatar, ne rewrites @erinnya-ly'omukozesa mentions (ne requested-by / assigned-by nnimiro) inside kaadi ne ky'okwogera birimu. exported fayiro carries nedda real mukozesa identity. word "mukozesa" follows lulimi lya muntu exporting. Ekya bulijjo kiri off.
disable-activities-description: Nga kisobozeseddwa, activity-feed entries biri never recorded ne never shown anywhere (lubaawo ebbali ne kaadi omulimu tab). Nedda history lya who did ki kiri kept. Ekya bulijjo kiri off.
disable-notifications-description: Nga kisobozeseddwa, WeKan never sends watch okumanyisa (in-app, imeyilo oba kirala services) ku lwa kyonna omulimu. Emirimu sobola still ba recorded (unless also kiremesezza above); kyokka okumanyisa biri suppressed. Ekya bulijjo kiri off.
disable-watch-description: Nga kisobozeseddwa, watch feature kiri turned off — bakozesa tasobola subscribe eri mbaawo, nkalala oba kaadi eri funa okumanyisa, ne kyonna attempt eri kyusa watch level kiri rejected. Ekya bulijjo kiri off.
backup-description: Kola kopi y'obukuumi y'ebiyungiddwa, ebifaananyi by'abakozesa ne/oba amawulire (ebikuŋŋaanyizo byonna eby'ebiwandiiko ebitali biyungiddwa oba bifaananyi by'abakozesa). .zip esindikibwa butereevu mu tterekero erirondeddwa — awatali fayiro ya kaseera — nga backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, erimu YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ne /data. Amaterekero g'ekire (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) gakozesa ebikwata ku kuyingira ebitegekeddwa mu tabu zaago ez'okutereka.
backup-scope-description: whole instance, oba one Ekitongole. Organization's kopi-ey'obukuumi contains kyakyo mbaawo ne everything ku them, including ebiyungiddwa lya ebyo mbaawo — but nedda mukozesa accounts ne nedda instance entegeka, because ebyo biri kigabiddwa nga every Ekitongole. Restoring Organization's kopi-ey'obukuumi kyokka ever writes eri mbaawo ekyo Ekitongole owns.
theme-override-all-tenants: Override ekyo applies eri byonna tenants
continuous-backup-description: Kisindika buli nkyukakyuka mu tterekero ly'amawulire, ebiyungiddwa, ebifaananyi by'abakozesa n'ebiwandiiko by'emirimu mu folda mu sikonda ntono, okusobola okuzzaawo embeera y'ekiseera kyonna. Kikola wamu n'okukola kopi z'obukuumi okutegekeddwa, okukola kopi enzijuvu.
continuous-backup-enabled: Kola kopi z'obukuumi obutayosa ku seva eno
continuous-backup-target: Folda ew'okutereka (ekkubo erijjuvu, ku disiki endala, mu tterekero erigabanyizibwa ku mukutu oba ekifo ekiyungiddwa ne rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (mu kiseera kye kimu, buli nkyukakyuka)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Empapula za SQLite (empapula ezikyuse mu buli bbanga eriteekeddwawo)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Tewali yingini y'etterekero ly'amawulire esobola kukola ku seva eno
continuous-backup-key-file: Fayiro y’ekisumuluzo ky’okukweka amawulire (ekkubo erijjuvu ebweru wa folda ew’okutereka; ennukuta 64 ez’enkola y’ennamba ez’omusingi 16 oba ebigambo eby’ekyama ebirimu ennukuta ezitakka wansi wa 16). Kuuma kopi: awatali fayiro eno kopi y’obukuumi tesobola kukomezebwawo.
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Fayiro y'etterekero ly'amawulire erya SQLite (ekolebwa ku mabbali ga kopi y'obukuumi, tewandiikibwa n'akatono ku fayiro eri mu kukozesebwa)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Kozesa etterekero ly’amawulire erya SQLite erizimbiddwa obuggya ku mulundi oguddako enkola lw’etandika nate (etterekero ly’amawulire ekkadde erikyusiddwa lijja kuterekebwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Zzaawo omulembe ogulondeddwa ku kiseera ekirondeddwa? Okukola kopi z'obukuumi obutayosa kuyimirira okumala akaseera nga okuzzaawo kugenda mu maaso.
continuous-backup-saved: Enteekateeka z'okukola kopi z'obukuumi obutayosa ziterekeddwa
backup-restore-confirm: Zzaawo kopi y'obukuumi erondeddwa? Ebiyungiddwa n'ebifaananyi by'abakozesa biwandiikibwa mu nkola ya fayiro, ate amawulire mu tterekero ly'amawulire okusinziira ku nkola erondeddwa.
gcs-key-filename-description: Optional: path eri service akaawunti JSON kisumuluzo fayiro ku seva.
gcs-credentials-description: Optional: teekamu service akaawunti JSON kisumuluzo. Leave blank eri kozesa kisumuluzo fayiro oba ekya bulijjo credentials.
gcs-permissions-note: Give WeKan's service akaawunti read/write access eri bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Etterekero → Buckets → kyo bucket → Permissions → Grant access. Mu "Kipya principals", teekamu service akaawunti imeyilo — "client_imeyilo" muwendo okuva kyo JSON kisumuluzo — olwo londa role "Etterekero Object Omuddukanya" ne Tereka.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Leave blank eri keep ekiriwo muwendo.
azure-account-name-description: linnya lya kyo Azure Etterekero akaawunti.
azure-container-description: blob container eri store fayiro mu.
gcs-bucket-description: linnya lya Cloud Etterekero bucket eri store fayiro mu.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: leave blank (uses region endpoint). S3-compatible: Endpoint URL okuva kyo MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces console.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → kyo bucket → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → kyo bucket linnya (oba Tonda bucket → Bucket linnya).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Bakozesa → kyo mukozesa → Obukuumi credentials → Access keys → Tonda access kisumuluzo → londa kozesa case 'Application running outside AWS' → Tonda access kisumuluzo. Shown nga 'Access kisumuluzo ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Kimu lutimbe nga Access kisumuluzo ID; 'Secret access key' kiri shown kyokka once nga kisumuluzo kiri yatonda — koppa kyo olwo (oba Wanula.csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Etterekero accounts → kyo akaawunti → linnya shown ku waggulu (also under Obukuumi + networking → Access keys → Etterekero akaawunti linnya).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Etterekero accounts → kyo akaawunti → Obukuumi + networking → Access keys → kisumuluzo1 → Laga → Kisumuluzo.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Etterekero accounts → kyo akaawunti → Obukuumi + networking → Access keys → kisumuluzo1 → Okuyungibwa string → Laga.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Etterekero accounts → kyo akaawunti → Mawulire etterekero → Containers → kyo container (oba + Container eri tonda one).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → project selector ku waggulu → kyo project's ID (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Etterekero → Buckets → kyo bucket linnya (oba Tonda eri make one).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Path ku WeKan seva eri downloaded service akaawunti JSON kisumuluzo fayiro (yatonda below). Kozesa kino Oba teekamu JSON into nnimiro below.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Omuddukanya → Service accounts → kyo service akaawunti → Keys → Yongerako kisumuluzo → Tonda kipya kisumuluzo → JSON → Tonda (downloads fayiro). Teekamu kyakyo contents here, oba tereka fayiro ne teeka kyakyo path above.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Tambusa ekiyungiddwa eri Azure Blob Etterekero
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Tambusa ekiyungiddwa eri Google Cloud Etterekero
gridfs-enabled-description: Kozesa MongoDB GridFS ku lwa fayiro etterekero
migration-stop-confirm: okakasa ggwe yagala eri yimiriza byonna okusengula?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Eri have ebiyungiddwa ne avatars kirabika, tambusa them okuva CollectionFS eri kyonna kirala Etterekero.
s3-access-key-description: AWS S3 access kisumuluzo ku lwa authentication
s3-bucket-description: S3 bucket linnya ku lwa storing fayiro
s3-enabled-description: Kozesa AWS S3 oba MinIO ku lwa fayiro etterekero
s3-endpoint-description: S3 endpoint URL (e.g., s3.amazonaws.com oba minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: AWS S3 secret kisumuluzo ku lwa authentication
s3-ssl-enabled-description: Kozesa SSL/TLS ku lwa S3 connections
writable-path-description: Base directory path ku lwa fayiro etterekero
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Performs comprehensive checks ne fixes ku lwa lubaawo mawulire integrity, including lukalala ordering, kaadi positions, ne akakubo structure.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Safely deletes kyereere duplicate nkalala. Kyokka removes nkalala ekyo have nedda kaadi Ne have another lukalala na kimu mutwe ekyo contains kaadi.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Finds ne restores kaadi ne nkalala na kibuze swimlaneId oba listId. Creates 'Lost Cards' akakubo eri make byonna lost items kirabika again.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Restores byonna kyaterekebwa obukubo, nkalala, ne kaadi. Kyokka fixes kyonna kibuze swimlaneId oba listId eri make items kirabika.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Detects ne repairs kibuze oba corrupted nkalala mu lubaawo structure.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Updates avatar URLs ku lwa lubaawo bamemba eri kozesa correct etterekero backend ne fixes broken avatar references.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Updates byonna fayiro ekiyungiddwa URLs ku kino lubaawo eri kozesa correct etterekero backend ne fixes broken fayiro references.
migrations-admin-only: Kyokka lubaawo administrators sobola run okusengula
migrations-description: Run mawulire integrity checks ne repairs ku lwa kino lubaawo. Each okusengula sobola ba executed individually.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Kino kijja perform comprehensive okusengula eri kebera ne fix lubaawo mawulire integrity. Kino kiyinza take few moments. Weyongereyo?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Kino kijja kisooka convert kyonna kigabiddwa nkalala eri per-swimlane nkalala, olwo sangula kyereere nkalala ekyo have duplicate lukalala na kimu mutwe containing kaadi. Kyokka truly redundant kyereere nkalala kijja ba yaggyewo. Weyongereyo?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Kino kijja tonda 'Lost Cards' akakubo ne zzaawo byonna kaadi ne nkalala na kibuze swimlaneId oba listId. Kino kyokka affects non-archived items. Weyongereyo?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Kino kijja zzaawo Byonna kyaterekebwa obukubo, nkalala, ne kaadi, making them kirabika again. Kyonna items na kibuze IDs kijja ba kyokka fixed. Kino tasobola ba easily undone. Weyongereyo?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Kino kijja detect ne repair kibuze oba corrupted nkalala mu lubaawo structure. Weyongereyo?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Kino kijja update avatar URLs ku lwa lubaawo bamemba eri kozesa correct etterekero backend. Weyongereyo?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Kino kijja update byonna fayiro ekiyungiddwa URLs ku kino lubaawo eri kozesa correct etterekero backend. Weyongereyo?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Nedda lost obukubo, nkalala, oba kaadi eri zzaawo
migration-progress-note: linda katono while we migrate kyo lubaawo eri latest structure...
conversion-info-text: Kino conversion kiri performed once per lubaawo ne improves enkola. Ggwe sobola weyongereyo ng'okozesa lubaawo normally.
converting-board-description: Converting lubaawo structure ku lwa improved functionality. Kino kiyinza take few moments.
migration-batch-size-description: Namba lya ebiyungiddwa eri process mu each batch (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Pause okusengula nga CPU usage exceeds kino percentage (10-90)
migration-info-text: Etterekero-ly'amawulire okusengula biri performed once ne improve nkola enkola. process continues mu emabega even singa ggwe ggalawo kyo browser.
migration-warning-text: Please do si ggalawo kyo browser during okusengula. process kijja weyongereyo mu emabega but kiyinza take longer eri complete.
account-locked: Akaawunti kiri temporarily kisibiddwa due eri too many kiremye okuyingira attempts. Please try again later.
username-too-short: Erinnya-ly'omukozesa kiteekwa ba ku least 3 characters
account-created: Akaawunti yatonda! Ggwe sobola now sign mu.
problems-summary-help: Kebera kizibu areas ggwe have reviewed, olwo click Acknowledge eri reset byabwe new-problem obungi.
problems-in-progress-help: Bino okusengula oba repairs biri running now. Logins sobola ba slow, oba laga "Kiteekwa ba logged mu" oba "Kitikka, linda katono" spinner, until they finish ne CPU drops.
problems-none-in-progress: Nedda okusengula oba repairs biri mu okugenda-mu-maaso.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: Repaired __fixed__ kaadi(s). __unfixable__ kaadi(s) have nedda lubaawo ne tasobola ba repaired kyokka.
restore-list-swimlanes-done: Kyazziddwawo __restored__ lukalala(s). __remaining__ could si ba kyazziddwawo.
export-card-details: Kaadi ebisingawo (each kaadi nga mu kaadi fulumya)
import-not-wekan-export: Ekyo fayiro kiri si WeKan fulumya
import-board-source: Leeta lubaawo (Trello, Jira, WeKan fulumya, CSV, Excel, …)
import-report-description: Olubaawo lukoleddwa, naye ebitundu ebimu ebya fayiro tebyasobodde kuleetebwa. Lipoota y'emu eterekeddwa mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya → Bizibu → Okuzzaawo.
import-parts-instruction: Kyokka ticked parts biri yaleeta. kimu choice kiri kyakozesebwa nga exporting.
import-file-label: Londa fayiro y'okufulumya, oba teekamu ebigambo byayo wansi:
sum-of-number-fields: Omugabi gw'ebifo by'ennamba ebyekozesebwa ebiraga waggulu w'olukalala
date-range-of-fields: Ebbanga ly'ennaku ku bifo eby'ennaku ebyalondebwa okulabika waggulu w'olukalala
twoFactorAuth-enabled: Okukakasa mu ngeri bbiri kukoledde ku akawunti yo.
twoFactorAuth-explanation: Yongera olutindo lw'obukuumi ku akawunti yo. Bwe kimala okukolebwa, ojja kwetaagisa okuyingiza akabonero okuva mu app y'okukakasa buli lwo weeyingira.
twoFactorAuth-scan-instructions: Kozesa app y'okukakasa okusomya akabonero ka QR (nga Google Authenticator, Authy), oluvannyuma oyingize namba ez'omukaaga ze kiraga okukakasa.
twoFactorCode-invalid: Akabonero k'okukakasa si ka mazima. Ddamu ogezeeko.
subtask-inherit-parent-labels: Sika obubaka bwa kaadi ya muzadde
subtask-mark-done: Teeka akabonero nti omulimu omutono guwedde
subtask-mark-not-done: Teeka akabonero nti omulimu omutono tegunnaggwa
subtask-done-no-permission: Tosobola kukyusa oba omulimu guno omutono guwedde
chart-forecast-none-remaining: Tewali kikyasigadde okulambika - kaadi zonna zimaze okukolebwa.
chart-forecast-no-velocity: Kaadi __remaining__ zikyali waggulu; tewali by'amaze okumala okukukugira olunaku.
chart-forecast-projected: Ku muwendo ogwakolebwa mu bbanga eddako ogwa kaadi __average__ ku wiiki, kaadi __remaining__ ezikyali waggulu zandimaze __date__.
list-sync-description: Kuuma olukalala luno lubeere lwa mulembe okuva mu nkola ey'ebweru. Omulimu ogw'ekyama gukebera buli daakiika 15; kozesa "Kwesigika kaakano" okukebera amangu.
drag-to-reorder: Sika okukyusa ensengeka. Amapeesa g’obusaale obw’okugenda waggulu ne wansi gasimbula ekifo kimu.
map-view-empty: Olubaawo luno terunnaba na kifaananyi kya maapu. Omuddukanya w'olubaawo asobola okutikka ekifaananyi — pulaani eraga ebisenge by'ekizimbe, maapu y'ekifo oba ekifaananyi ekikubiddwa — oluvannyuma kaadi ne ziteekebwa ku kyo.
map-view-place-hint: Sika kaadi ogiteeke ku maapu, oba gironde oluvannyuma onyige mu kifo w'erina okubeera.
flow-error: Lipoota teyinzizza kutikkibwa. Kebera emiwendo era ogezeeko nate.
flow-note-agingWip: Amakaadi agaggule: ennaku okuva lwe gayingira mu mutendera oguliwo kati. Ebikondo ebimyufu bisukka ekitundu kya 85 eky'ebyafaayo by'omutendera ogwo (waakiri okubeerawo okutaano). Ebyafaayo by'okuyingira ebibulamu tebimanyiddwa.
flow-note-blockerAnalysis: Ebyafaayo by'ebyesigamiziddwa biwa ebiseera eby'okutandika n'okukoma kw'ebiziyiza mu buli mutendera. Enkolagana enkadde ziyinza okuba n'entandikwa ezitamanyiddwa. Amakaadi agasanguddwa geetaaga ebifaananyi by'ebyafaayo ebiterekeddwa. Ensonga ezikwatagana zibalibwa kinnoomu.
flow-note-monteCarlo: Okugezesa 2,000 kulonda ennaku za kalenda eza UTC enzijuvu, nga mw'otwalidde ennaku ezitaliiko kimaliriziddwa. sync-conflict-detach-hint: Ggyawo okugatta kwa Sync okw'eddiŋŋana lino lyokka. Ebirimu bisigala mu WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Okuteeka mu Tterekero kuziyiziddwa kaadi entono ezikola
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Ekintu ensibuko kyagenda, naye kaadi entono ezikola ziziyiza okuteeka mu Tterekero. Kuuma kaadi eno mu kifo kyo ng'oggyawo okugatta kwayo kwa Sync. Kaadi entono tezikyusibwa.
sync-conflict-keep-card-local: Kuuma kaadi eno mu kifo kyo
sync-conflict-creation: Kola kaadi ya Sync ey'okudda mu kifo
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Kuuma kaadi eyasooka nga bw'eri era okole kaadi ya Sync empya mu lukalala luno. Okuddamu okugezaako kukozesa nate eyo edda mu kifo.
sync-preview-saved: Kisinziira ku ntegeka eziterekeddwa. Sync kati ekima era n'ekebera ensibuko nate.
sync-preview-unavailable: Tereka ensibuko ya Sync nga tonnasaba kyakulabirako.
sync-preview-blocked: Gonjoola obutakkaanya obuli wansi nga tonneekenneenya nteekateeka y'enkyukakyuka.
sync-preview-scope: Emiwendo gikwata ku nnimiro z'ensibuko ezitegekeddwa. Data endala eyinza okulekebwa ekisoma ensibuko.
sync-source-scope: Amakubo gagatta ennimiro we zirabikira mu bintu by'ensibuko. Ebintu ebitagattiddwa byalangirirwa nga byonna; emiwendo gyabyo tegiragibwa.
sync-source-converted: Kikyusiddwa okufuuka ebigambo oba engeri endala
sync-source-occurrences: Ennimiro oba ebintu ebyalangiriddwa we birabikira
sync-source-truncated: Alipoota ekomeddwa ku makubo 100 n'amannya g'ennimiro agasaliddwako.
sync-report-retention: Okudduka 20 okusembyeyo. Alipoota zikuumibwa okumala ennaku 30.
sync-report-partial: Okudduka okwalemye oba okutaggwa kuyinza okuba nga kwakyusa kaadi ezimu. Alipoota zino tezizza mu maaso wadde okusazaamu okudduka.
sync-report-unfinished: Kikyagenda mu maaso oba kyasalibwako; ekivuddemu tekiwandiikiddwa
sync-report-unavailable: Alipoota z'okudduka zeetaaga olukusa lw'okuwandiika ku lukalala lwonna ne seva eriwo.
sync-recovery-description: Alipoota za Sync ezikuumiddwa okuva mu nnaku 30 ezisembyeyo. Noonya ku ID y'olubaawo oba y'olukalala. Ekivuddemu ekitaggwa kiyinza okuba nga kikyadduka oba kyasalibwako. Zza obuggya okukebera nate; alipoota zino tezisobola kuzza mu maaso wadde okusazaamu enkyukakyuka.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Tekisoboka kusoma kwekebejja kwa Sync. Kebera olukusa lw'omuddukanya n'oba seva eriwo.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Londa ennimiro ey'ennamba erina ID y'ennimiro ya Jira n'ekipimo ky'okubalirira, nga bwe yakolebwa okuyingiza kwa Jira okugattiddwa. Enkyukakyuka ez'omu kifo zeekenneenyezebwa nga obutakkaanya. Emiwendo gy'ensibuko egibulawo gibuusibwa amaaso; null eyogeddwa obulungi esiimuula omuwendo ogugattiddwa.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Obuzito oba okubalirira kw’obudde kwa GitLab kuwandiikibwa mu kifo ky’ennamba ky’olonda. Enkyukakyuka ez’awano zeekenneenyezebwa ng’obutakkaanya; ensonga etaliiko buzito esangula omuwendo ogugattiddwa.
email-recovery-description: Olunyiriri lumu ku buli afuna obubaka. Noonya ng'okozesa ID y'omukozesa. Ebirimu mu bubaka n'ebifo by'imeyilo y'afuna obubaka tebiragibwa. Okuyimiriza okumala akaseera kukwata obubaka obuliwo n'obujja; Okugenda mu maaso kuddamu okugezaako okuweereza obubaka obuli mu lunyiriri kati. Okusazaamu kuggyawo obubaka obwateekebwa mu lunyiriri okutuuka ku ssaawa y'okusaba. Bwe kiba nti okuweereza kukyagenda mu maaso, gezaako nate oluvannyuma lw'akaseera. Obubaka obwatandise okuweerezebwa tebusobola kukomezebwawo, era okuweereza okutakakasiddwa kusobola okuddamu. Okulemererwa okw'olubeerera n'obubaka obutuuse ku kkomo ly'okugezaako bisigalawo okwekebejjebwa. Okuddamu okugezaako obubaka obwalemererwa kutandika oluzingulula olupya olw'okugezaako era kukuuma okuyimiriza okw'akaseera okuliwo.
email-recovery-changed: Enkyukakyuka esembayo ey'omukozi akola ku nkola
email-recovery-empty: Tewali bubaka mu lunyiriri era tewali bafuna obubaka abayimiriziddwa okuweerezebwa okumala akaseera.
email-recovery-unavailable: Tekisobose okusoma olunyiriri lw'imeyilo. Kebera olukusa lw'omuddukanya n'okuba nti seva esobola okutuukibwako.
email-recovery-busy: Okuweereza oba omulimu omulala ogw'olunyiriri gukolebwa. Zza buggya era gezaako nate oluvannyuma lw'akaseera.
email-recovery-failed: Omulimu tegusobose kukakasibwa. Zza olunyiriri buggya era gezaako nate ekikolwa kye kimu bwe kiba kyetaagisa.
email-recovery-superseded: Ekikolwa ekipya eky'omukozi akola ku nkola kizzewo okusaba kuno. Embeera y'olunyiriri eya kati eragibwa.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Sazaamu obubaka bwonna obuli mu lunyiriri kati obw'omuntu ono? Ebirimu bijja kuggyibwawo era tebisobola kukomezebwawo. Obubaka obupya obukoleddwa oluvannyuma lw'okusaba kuno bujja kusigalawo.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Okutuusa tekwasobodde kukakasibwa; kyekenneenye nga tonnaddamu kugezaako
sync-time-estimate-hint: Okubalirira kw'obudde kukozesa ennimiro ez'ennamba ez'obudde obwasooka/obusigaddeyo ezaakolebwa okuyingiza kwa Jira. Ennimiro emu yokka ekwatagana erina okubeera ku lubaawo luno. Enkyukakyuka ez'omu kifo zeekenneenyezebwa nga obutakkaanya; emiwendo gy'ensibuko egibulawo gibuusibwa amaaso era null eyogeddwa obulungi esiimuula omuwendo.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint n'ebifulumizibwa bikwataganyizibwa nga Scrum ekoleezeddwa ku lubaawo luno kyokka. Sprint oba ekifulumizibwa ekibulawo kikolebwa ku lubaawo luno, n'ennaku ensibuko z'ewa; ekiriwo kikwataganyizibwa ku ID yaakyo ey'ensibuko okusooka, oluvannyuma ku linnya. Enkyukakyuka y'entegeka ey'omu kifo esigalawo okutuusa ensibuko lw'ekyusa entegeka y'ensonga eyo, era Sync esooka tegiggyawo ntegeka.
activity-recovery-description: Obubaka obutaggwa buddamu okugezesebwa mu ngeri ey'otoma. Ekenneenya emirimu egibulawo oba egikyusiddwa nga tonnaddamu kugezaako. Okuddamu okugezaako tekuddamu kukola mulimu.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Tekisobose kufuna bubaka bwa mirimu obulindiridde.
activity-recovery-busy: Omukozi omulala akola ku bubaka buno. Zza obuggya oddemu ogezeeko.
activity-recovery-denied: Olukusa lw'afuna oba by'ayagala ku bubaka tebikyakkiriza kutuusa.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Omulimu ogwasooka gubulawo oba gukyusiddwa. Tewali kyaddamu kukolebwa.
activity-recovery-failed: Tekisobose kumaliriza kutuusa bubaka. Omulimu ogulindiridde gukuumiddwa.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Obubaka buno bwakyuse okuva lwe bwafunibwa. Ekenneenya embeera empya nga tonnaddamu kugezaako.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Tekisobose kukakasa ntegeka ya kutuusa. Zza obuggya era wekenneenye embeera yaayo eriwo kati.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Sazaamu ddala okutuusa okusigaddeyo okw'omulimu guno? Kino tekisobola kuddamu kutandikibwa. Imeyilo ezaali ziteekeddwa dda mu lunyiriri n'obubaka obwatuusibwa tebiddizibwayo.
rule-email-recovery-description: Kebera okugezaako okuwandiikiddwa okw'okusindika imeyilo z'amateeka. Okugezaako okutannakakasibwa kuyinza okuba nga kukyasindika oba nga kwataataaganyizibwa. Lipoota eno teddamu kusindika era tesazaamu kusindika.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Tewali kugezaako kusindika imeyilo z'amateeka kukwatagana na kunoonya kuno.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Tekisobose kufuna kugezaako kwa imeyilo za mateeka. Zza obuggya oddemu ogezeeko.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan teddamu kusindika imeyilo etennakakasibwa ku bwayo. Okuddamu okusindika kuba eri abafuna abatannakakasibwa bokka. Gisseeko akabonero nti yasindikiddwa bw'oba omanyi nti yatuuse, oba gisazeemu.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Okusindika okwasooka kuyinza okuba nga kukyagenda mu maaso. Osobola okusalawo oluvannyuma lwa __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Ddamu osindikire abafuna abatannakakasibwa imeyilo eno? Buli muntu ajja kugifuna emirundi ebiri singa seva ye eya imeyilo yagikkiriza nga WeKan temanyisiddwa.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Teeka ku imeyilo eno akabonero nti yasindikiddwa eri bonna? Kino kikole bw'oba omanyi nti yatuuse kyokka.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Osazeemu imeyilo eno? Tejja kusindikibwa eri abafuna abatannakakasibwa.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Okusindika okwasooka kuyinza okuba nga kukyagenda mu maaso. Gezako nate oluvannyuma.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Okuddamu okusindika okw'emabega kuyinza okuba nga kukyagenda mu maaso. Gezako nate oluvannyuma.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Buli afuna yakakasibwa dda. Gisseeko akabonero nti yasindikiddwa mu kifo ky'okuddamu okugisindika.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seva ya imeyilo teyazzeemu. Imeyilo eyaddamu okusindikibwa eyinza okuba nga yatuuse oba nga tetuuse; eragibwa ng'ekyagenda mu maaso.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Omuddukanya omulala akola ku imeyilo eno. Gezako nate mu kaseera katono.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imeyilo eterekeddwa tekyakwatagana na kugezaako kuno, n'olwekyo tesobola kukolebwako wano.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Ebiwandiiko ebyaterekebwa ku kugezaako kuno si bituufu, n'olwekyo tekusobola kukolebwako wano.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Tekisobose kukola ku imeyilo eno. Ddamu otikke era ogezeeko nate.
rule-email-legacy-description: Imeyilo z'amateeka zino zategekebwa enkyusa ya WeKan ey'edda etaawandiika nsibuko y'ebizirimu, n'olwekyo WeKan tejja kuzisindika ku bwayo. Sooka okebere oba eyakola etteeka akyalina olukusa okuyingira, olwo oddemu okuyunga imeyilo etegekebwe nate okuva ku kaadi nga bw'eri kati, oba gisuule.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Ebikwata ku kaadi okuva mu nkyusa ey'edda
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Ddamu otegeke imeyilo eno okuva ku kaadi nga bw'eri kati? Ebigirimu biyinza okwawukana ku ebyategekebwa emabega.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Osuule imeyilo eno? Tegenda kusindikibwa n'akatono.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Tekisobose kutikka imeyilo z'amateeka ezirindirira okukeberebwa. Ddamu otikke ogezeeko nate.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Eyakola etteeka takyalina lukusa okuyingira ku kaadi eno, oba etteeka lyakyuka, n'olwekyo imeyilo tesobola kuddamu kuyungibwa. Osobola okugisuula.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Ekikolwa ekyatandika imeyilo eno kyakyuka, n'olwekyo tesobola kuddamu kuyungibwa. Osobola okugisuula.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Kaadi imeyilo eno kwe yava tekyaliwo, n'olwekyo tesobola kuddamu kuyungibwa. Osobola okugisuula.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Okuddukanya etteeka okwategeka imeyilo eno tekukyali mu biterekeddwa, n'olwekyo tesobola kuddamu kuyungibwa. Osobola okugisuula.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Imeyilo eno yasindikibwa dda, yagezesebwa okusindikibwa, oba yasuulibwa.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Tekisobose kumaliriza kikolwa kino. Ddamu otikke era ogezeeko nate.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Emirimu gya List Sync egitasobola kuddamu kukolebwa
stuck-sync-operation-description: Buli gumu ku mirimu gino egya List Sync egyaterekebwa gwayimirira wakati era tegukyasobola kumalirizibwa, kubanga olukalala lwagwo lwaggyibwawo, lwaddamu okukolebwa oba lwaddamu okutegekebwa, oba omukozesa eyagutandika yafiirwa olukusa lw'okuwandiika. Nga waliwo gumu ogulindiridde, olukalala olwo terusobola kukola Sync. Gusuule okuleka olukalala okuddamu okukola Sync: enkyukakyuka ezaali zikoleddwa dda zisigalawo, enkyukakyuka ezaaterekebwa ezisigaddeyo teziwandiikibwa n'akatono, era Sync eddako egeraageranya olukalala n'ensibuko yaalwo nate.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Olukalala lwaggyibwawo, lwaddamu okukolebwa oba entegeka zaalwo eza Sync zaakyuka
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Omukozesa eyagutandika takyalina lukusa lwa kuwandiika ku lukalala lwonna
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Gwaterekebwa WeKan version eyasooka nga tegulina ekyagutandika
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Gusobola okuddamu okukolebwa kati era gujja kuggwa gwokka, kale tegusobola kusuulibwa.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Suula omulimu guno ogwa List Sync ogwaterekebwa? Enkyukakyuka gwe gwali gukoze dda zisigalawo; ezisigaddeyo teziwandiikibwa n'akatono. Olukalala lusobola okuddamu okukola Sync.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Tewali mirimu gya List Sync egirindiridde kwekenneenyezebwa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: 50 egisinga obukadde gyokka gye giragiddwa. Suula egimu ozze obuggya okulaba egisingawo.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Tekisobose kufuna mirimu gya List Sync. Zza obuggya oddemu ogezeeko.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Omulimu guno tegusangiddwa nga gusibye, kale tegusobola kusuulibwa.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Omulimu guno gusobola okuddamu okukolebwa kati era gujja kuggwa gwokka, kale tegwasuuliddwa.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Olukalala luno lukola Sync kati. Ddamu ogezeeko mu kaseera.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Tekisobose kumaliriza kikolwa kino. Ddamu otikke era ogezeeko nate.
interrupted-import-description: Buli kumu ku kuyingiza embaawo kuno kwayimirira wakati - seva yaddamu okutandika, oba okuyingiza kwalemwa - era kwaleka olubaawo olw'ekitundu. Okuyingiza tekusobola kugenda mu maaso, kubanga fayiro yaakwo ensibuko tekuumibwa. Kuuma olubaawo nga bwe luli, oba lusuule oddemu oyingize fayiro. Okusuula kuggyawo olubaawo okuyingiza kuno lwe kwakola na buli kimu ekiriko, nga mw'otwalidde buli kimu ekyalwongerwako okuva olwo.
interrupted-import-scrum: Omutendera gwakwo ogwa Scrum gulina ekifo kyagwo eky'okukebera (__state__, __next__ ku mitendera __total__). Bw'okuuma olubaawo, kumaliriza oba kusuule okuva mu kuzzaawo okuyingiza kwa Scrum okw'olubaawo.
interrupted-import-counts: Obukubo __swimlanes__, enkalala __lists__, kaadi __cards__, enkalala z'okukebera __checklists__, endowooza __comments__, ebiyungiddwako __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Kuuma olubaawo luno olw'ekitundu nga bwe luli? Tewali kiggyibwawo, era okuyingiza tekukyawandiikibwa wano.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Suula okuyingiza kuno? Olubaawo lwe kwakola na buli kimu ekiriko biggyibwawo ddala.
interrupted-import-empty: Tewali kuyingiza mbaawo okwasalibwako okulindiridde kwekenneenyezebwa.
interrupted-import-truncated: 50 egisinga obukadde gyokka gye giragiddwa. Kuuma oba suula egimu ozze obuggya okulaba egisingawo.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Tekisobose kufuna kuyingiza mbaawo okwasalibwako. Zza obuggya oddemu ogezeeko.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Olubaawo olulina id eno terwakolebwa kuyingiza kuno, kale terwakwatiddwako.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Omutendera gwakwo ogwa Scrum gukyawandiikibwa oba gukyazzibwawo. Ddamu ogezeeko mu dakiika ntono.
interrupted-import-failed: Tekisobose kumaliriza kikolwa kino. Ddamu otikke era ogezeeko nate.
saml-login-not-started: Okuyingira kuno okwa SAML tekwatandikidde mu tabu eno eya bulawuza. Ddamu oyingire.
history-request-pending-undo: Seva tennakakasa kukomyawo mabega kwo okusembyeyo.
history-request-pending-redo: Seva tennakakasa kuddamu kukola kwo okusembyeyo.
history-request-hint: Bw'oddamu okugezaako, osindika okusaba kwe kumu nate, kale tekisobola kukomyawo mabega nkyukakyuka ya kubiri.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Okuddayo, okuddamu oba okuzzaawo enkyukakyuka za Scrum kwayimiridde ku butakkaanya. Okukyusa Scrum ku lubaawo luno kuziyiziddwa okutuusa nga kugonjoddwa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Enkyukakyuka __applied__ ku __total__ zaawandiikibwa, __pending__ tezaawandiikibwa, ate __conflicted__ zaakyusibwa omuntu omulala okuva olwo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Okuzza emabega kuzzaawo buli kiwandiiko ekyakyusibwa nga bwe kyali edda; kuweebwa kyokka nga tewali muntu mulala eyakyusa ebiwandiiko ebyo okuva olwo. Okukuuma olubaawo nga bwe luli kuggyawo omulimu ogwayimiridde era tekukyusa biwandiiko. Mu ngeri zombi, kiwandiikibwa mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya, Ebizibu, Okuzzaawo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Kuuma buli kiwandiiko nga bwe kiri kati, nga mw'otwalidde enkyukakyuka omulimu ogwayimiridde ze gwali guwandiise dda?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Omuddukanya olubaawo asobola okukizza emabega oba okukuuma olubaawo nga bwe luli.
header-login: Okuyingira okuyita mu mitwe gya HTTP
login-setting-clear-secret: Ggyawo omuwendo oguterekeddwa mu kifo ky'abaddukanya
login-setting-after-restart: Kitandika okukola nga WeKan etandikiddwa buto
login-setting-env-only: Embeera ya seva yokka y'eteekawo bino. Biragiddwa wano nga bya kusoma kwokka.
email-to-card-description: Imeyilo esindikiddwa ku ndagiriro y'olubaawo lwo efuuka ekaadi ku lubaawo olwo.
email-to-card-webhook: URL ya webhook y'imeyilo eziyingira okuva ku mugabi (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark oba MIME relay embisi)
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Olubaawo imeyilo ezisindikibwa ku grain eno gye zigenda
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Tewali - imeyilo zokka ezirina akabonero k'olubaawo mu subject
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Teeka kino mu subject okutuuka ku lubaawo luno nga ggwe:
email-to-card-address-private: Gikuume nga ya kyama: buli agirina asobola okwongerako kaadi nga ggwe.
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Okufuna imeyilo tekuteekeddwateekeddwa mu Kifo ky'abaddukanya.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Omuddukanya w'olubaawo tannaggulawo imeyilo ku lubaawo luno.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Waggyako endagiriro z'embaawo zo mu Ntegeka za Bamemba.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain tennafuna ndagiriro yaayo ey'imeyilo. Ddamu otikke omuko.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Weetaaga olukusa okuwandiika ku lubaawo luno.
inbound-domain-invalid: Eryo si linnya lya domain ettuufu.
inbound-account-invalid: Bbokisi ya IMAP yeetaaga erinnya lya seva ettuufu.
feature-views-email-desc: Olubaawo ng'ekisanduuko ky'ebbaluwa: olukalala lw'imeyilo lwe Kisanduuko ekiyingira, enkalala ze fayiro, obubonero bwe bubonero, era abamemba bawandiika era baddamu imeyilo okuva ku ndagiriro y'olubaawo.
email-view-not-receiving: Olubaawo luno terunnafuna imeyilo. Lukoleeze mu Nteekateeka z'obubaka bw'olubaawo → Imeyilo okufuuka ekaadi.
email-view-invalid-address: Endagiriro emu si ndagiriro ya imeyilo ntuufu.
email-view-too-many: Imeyilo nnyingi nnyo zaweerezeddwa mu ssaawa ewedde. Gezaako oluvannyuma.
feature-views-chat-desc: Olubaawo ng'ekifo eky'okunyumyiramu: ebifo by'emirimu, embaawo, obukubo, enkalala n'ekaadi ng'omuti gw'emikutu, ekaadi wakati n'endowooza zaayo ng'obubaka bw'okunyumya.
chat-view-pick-card: Londa ekaadi okuva mu mikutu okugiraba wano.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Kaadi ze zimu mu bibinja by'empagi ebiwerako ebirina amannya - okusinziira ku kumaliriza, obukulu, omutendera oba ekirala kyonna - zisengulwa wakati w'empagi nga zisikibwa.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu ya bboodi → Amateeka gaweereza amateeka okuva ku bantu bye bakola n'omukono emirundi mingi.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu ya bboodi → Mu bufunze kiraga buli muntu ky'akoze ku bboodi ku lunaku oba wiiki esembayo, n'ebyayitako ekiseera.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu ya bboodi → Okuva lwe wasembayo okujja kiraga abalala bye bakyusizza ku bboodi.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Okunoonya okwa wonna kutegeera ebigambo nga "kaadi zange eziyise ekiseera".
column-sets-empty: Tewannabaawo bibinja by'empagi. Omuddukanya w'olubaawo asobola okukola kimu: kituume erinnya, oluvannyuma ogattako empagi zaakyo.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Olubaawo ng'ekikebera ensonga za GitHub oba Gitea: kaadi ng'ensonga, obubonero n'ebituuko, endowooza ng'emboozi, ebiyungiddwako ng'efayiro, n'ebyafaayo by'olubaawo n'okuzzaayo.
vcs-no-milestones: Tewannabaawo bituuko. Akabonero akalina olunaku olusembayo kye kituuko.
vcs-no-list: Olubaawo luno terulina lukalala wadde ekkubo ery'ensonga.
card-qr-code-desc: Gikebere okuggulawo kaadi eno ku ssimu oba ku tabuleti.
card-qr-code-too-long: Enyunzi ya kaadi eno mpanvu nnyo ku koodi ya QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Tewannabaawo wiki. Okuyingiza ekibiina kya GitHub kuleeta wiki ya tterekero wano.
github-org-import-desc: Buli tterekero ly'ekibiina oba ly'omukozesa lifuuka lubaawo lwalyo, oluggulwa mu Board View / Version Control: ensonga zaalyo n'endowooza zaazo, obubonero ne fayiro, ebifulumiziddwa byalyo, enkola za GitHub Actions zaalyo nga Mateeka, ne wiki yaalyo.
github-org-import-token-hint: Kyetaagisa ku materekero ag'ekyama n'ekkomo lya API erisingako. Kikozesebwa kyokka ng'okuyingiza kukyagenda mu maaso era tekiterekebwa n'akatono.
github-org-import-actions: Enkola za GitHub Actions nga Mateeka
github-org-import-result: Ensonga %s, ebifulumiziddwa %s, amateeka %s, empapula za wiki %s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Wandiika erinnya ly'ekibiina oba ery'omukozesa, oba endagiriro yaakyo eya GitHub.
optional-apis-desc: REST API ezifaanana nga API z'ebirondoozi ebirala, apps zaabwe ne scripts zisobole okukozesa WeKan eno ng'emabega lyazo: bye zitereka biterekebwa mu WeKan, ku mbaawo za WeKan. Buli emu eba nzikize okutuusa lw'eteekebwako akabonero wano. Tewali n'emu erina obuyinza bwayo: kasitoma ayingira ne token ya API eya WeKan era asobola okulaba n'okukyusa ebyo byokka omuntu oyo by'asobola okulaba n'okukyusa mu WeKan. Zonna zeetaaga WeKan REST API okuba nga ekola (WITH_API=true). Endagiriro eri wansi wa buli emu y'eyo kasitoma gy'akozesa nga seva ye.
optional-api-trello-desc: Apps ne scripts ezaawandiikibwa ku lwa REST API ya Trello (okugeza Trellinator) zikola ne WeKan: embaawo, enkalala, kaadi, obubonero, abamemba, endowooza n'enkalala z'okukebera. Token ya Trello ye token ya API eya WeKan. Okusazaamu kaadi kugitwala mu tterekero mu WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Bakasitoma ba REST API v2 eya Jira bakola ne WeKan: pulojekiti lubaawo (ekisumuluzo kyayo kye kisumuluzo ky'olubaawo), ensonga ye kaadi (DEV-7), embeera lwe lukalala, era enkyukakyuka etambuza kaadi. Okunoonya kukkiriza JQL ennyangu: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ne ORDER BY. Yingira ne token ya API eya WeKan ng'ekigambo ky'okuyingira. Okusazaamu ensonga kugitwala mu tterekero.
optional-api-github-desc: Bakasitoma ba REST API ya GitHub ku nsonga bakola ne WeKan: etterekero lya koodi lubaawo, ensonga ye kaadi, n'obubonero, ebituuko (obubonero obulina olunaku olw'enkomerero), endowooza, n'okuba nga eggule oba eggale nga mu Endaba y'olubaawo / Okufuga enkyusa. Token ye token ya API eya WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Bakasitoma ba REST API ya Gitea ne Forgejo ku nsonga bakola ne WeKan mu ngeri y'emu nga API ekwatagana ne GitHub: etterekero lya koodi lubaawo ate ensonga ye kaadi. Token ye token ya API eya WeKan.
bots-none: Tewannabaawo bboti. Bboti kidduka ku seeva yo - omukozi wa AI, omulimu gwa CI, sikulipiti - olubaawo luno lwe luwa kaadi.
bot-not-found: Bboti eyo teri ku lubaawo luno.
bot-option-not-found: Okuddamu okwo si kwe bboti yawaayo.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhooks ezifuluma tezisobola kutuuka ku ndagiriro eziri ku mukutu gwa WeKan gwennyini, waleme kubaawo muntu yenna asobola okulaga webhook y'olubaawo ku mpeereza ey'omunda. Wandiika wano ba host abali ku mukutu ogwo webhooks be zisobola okutuukako - Node-RED, seva y'okunyumya - omu ku buli lunyiriri, ng'erinnya oba ndagiriro, ne port okukkiriza port eyo yokka. Kikalu: tewali. Abaddukanya omukutu bokka be basobola okukyusa olukalala luno.
account-webhook-desc: Endagiriro emu WeKan gy'etegeeza ng'omuntu ayingidde oba ng'akawunti empya ekoleddwa. Tewali kiweerezebwa okutuusa ng'ekibaddewo wansi kiteereddwako akabonero. Etwala ekibaddewo, erinnya ly'omukozesa n'obudde; teeka akabonero ku bifo ebirala singa oyo afuna abyetaaga.
account-webhook-field-ip: Endagiriro ya IP okuyingira gye kwavudde
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Sazaamu obubaka bwonna obulindiridde obw'emirimu egisukka ennaku mmeka?
vcs-synced-from: Kwataganyiziddwa okuva ku %s: giggulire era ogiggalire eyo.
vcs-synced-issue: Ensonga eno ekwataganyiziddwa: giggulire era ogiggalire mu nkola yaayo egigoberera.
sync-write-back: Wandiika enkyukakyuka okudda ku GitLab: omutwe, ennyonyola, endowooza, okuggalawo n'okuddamu okuggulawo
email-bounces-description: Ekyo WeKan ky'ekola ku imeyilo ezikomawo: endagiriro ewandiikiddwa obubi, ebbokisi ejjudde, okuddamu nti omuntu taliiwo, okwemulugunya ku spam. Buli kika kirina ebikolwa byakyo, ebikolebwa nga kikomyewo emirundi egyo.
email-bounces-enabled: Kola ku imeyilo ezikomawo mu WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Lekera awo okuweereza imeyilo ku ndagiriro eno
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Endagiriro teriiwo: ensobi mu kuwandiika, akawunti esaziddwamu, domain etamanyiddwa.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Tetuuse kati: ebbokisi ejjudde, seva erina emirimu mingi. Emirundi mingi egiddiringana gyokka gye gitegeeza ekintu.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Okuddamu nti omuntu taliiwo, ali mu luwummula oba okuva mu nkola ya tikiti. Imeyilo yatuuka.
email-bounces-ses-description: Mu Amazon SES, weereza obubaka bwa Bounce ne Complaint, n'etteeka ly'okufuna ku ndagiriro WeKan gy'eweerereza, ku mutwe gwa SNS, era wandiisa endagiriro eno ku gwo ng'oyita mu HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN z'emitwe gya SNS ez'okukkiriza, emu ku buli lunyiriri
email-bounces-stopped-only: Endagiriro zokka WeKan z'etaweereza imeyilo nate
email-bounces-clear-hint: Erabira okukomawo kw'endagiriro eno era ogiweereze imeyilo nate
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Ekyo si ARN y'omutwe gwa SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: WeKan bw'eba eweereza ng'eyita mu emu ku mpeereza zino, gikoleeze, wa empeereza endagiriro eno eya webhook ku bintu byayo eby'imeyilo ezikomawo n'okwemulugunya ku spam, era wano teekamu ekisumuluzo ky'ekozesa okubiteekako omukono, oba ekigambo ekyekusifu ky'otadde mu ndagiriro nga https://user:password@… oba ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Empeereza ekoleezeddwa yeetaaga ekisumuluzo kyayo eky'omukono oba ekigambo ekyekusifu.
activity-pub-enabled: Embaawo ez'olukale zifulumya emirimu gy'ekaadi zaazo ku fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Kiggale okusookera ddala. Bw'okikoleeza, buli lubaawo lwa lukale lusobola okugobererwa okuva ku Mastodon ne seva endala eza fediverse nga @board-<id> ku ndagiriro ya WeKan eno, era emirimu emipya egy'ekaadi gituuka ku bagoberezi baalwo. Kya kusoma kyokka: tewali kintu seva ya fediverse ky'esindika kikyusa lubaawo, era embaawo ez'ekyama tezifulumizibwa n'akatono.
caldav-sync-desc: Teeka ennaku ezisembayo ez'ekaadi z'olubaawo luno mu kalenda - Nextcloud Calendar oba kalenda yonna eya CalDAV. Olunaku olusembayo olukyusibwa mu kalenda luddayo ku kaadi. Kozesa ekigambo ekyekusifu eky'apu, so si ekigambo kyo ekyekusifu.
caldav-enabled: Kwataganya ennaku ezisembayo ne kalenda eno
caldav-invalid-url: Endagiriro ya kalenda erina okuba endagiriro ya http:// oba https://, nga temuli linnya lya mukozesa oba kigambo kyekusifu.
caldav-not-linked: Sooka otereke endagiriro ya kalenda era okoleeze okukwataganya.
webdav-storage-description: Tereka ebiyungiddwako mu folda ku seva ya WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud oba endala yonna. Kozesa ekigambo ekyekusifu eky'apu ekyakolerwa WeKan. Seva eri ku mukutu gwa WeKan gwennyini esobola okukozesebwa wano, kubanga omuddukanya w'omukutu yekka y'ateeka endagiriro eno.
sqrl-desc: Kiggaddwako mu butonde. Bwe kiteekebwako, olupapula lw'okuyingira luwa SQRL, era abammemba basooka kwongerako endagamuntu yaabwe eya SQRL mu Ntegeka z'omumemba. SQRL yeetaaga WeKan okuba ku ndagiriro ya https://.
sqrl-scan: Sika koodi n'app yo eya SQRL, oba ggulawo pulogulaamu yo eya SQRL ku kyuma kino.
sqrl-expired: Koodi eno eya SQRL eweddeko obudde. Tandika buggya.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL yeetaaga WeKan okuba ku ndagiriro ya https://.
sqrl-description: Yingira ng'okozesa endagamuntu yo eya SQRL mu kifo ky'ekigambo ekyekusifu. Gyongereko wano omulundi gumu ng'okozesa pulogulaamu yo eya SQRL; osobola okugiggyawo wano essaawa yonna.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Okuyingira ng'okozesa SQRL kuggaddwa ku akawunti eno okuva mu pulogulaamu yo eya SQRL. Kuddemu okukuggulawo eyo ng'okozesa koodi yo ey'okuwonya.
sqrl-only-on: Pulogulaamu yo eya SQRL esibye akawunti eno ku SQRL yokka: engeri endala zonna ez'okuyingira zigaaniddwa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Pulogulaamu yo eya SQRL esibye akawunti eno ddala: okuzzaawo ekigambo ekyekusifu n'okukyusa imeyilo bigaaniddwa.
sqrl-only: Akawunti eno eyingira ng'ekozesa SQRL yokka.
sqrl-hardlock: Akawunti eno esibiddwa ku SQRL: tesobola kuzzibwawo wadde okukyusibwa mu ngeri endala yonna.
windows-sso-failed: Okuyingira ng'okozesa Windows kulemye. Akawunti yo eya Windows oboolyawo tekkirizibwa wano.
